definition.en: Trade agreements are formal arrangements between two or more nations to reduce trade barriers and facilitate the exchange of goods and services.
definition.hi: Trade agreements are formal arrangements between two or more nations to reduce trade barriers and facilitate the exchange of goods and services.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding trade agreements is crucial for the GS-3 syllabus as they directly impact India's balance of payments, export competitiveness, and domestic industrial policy. Questions frequently appear on the implications of FTAs, PTAs, and CEPA/CECA on the Indian economy.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding trade agreements is crucial for the GS-3 syllabus as they directly impact India's balance of payments, export competitiveness, and domestic industrial policy. Questions frequently appear on the implications of FTAs, PTAs, and CEPA/CECA on the Indian economy.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the economic impact of different types of trade agreements on India.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the economic impact of different types of trade agreements on India.

learningOutcomes.en: Evaluate the role of trade policy in the broader context of the Indian economy.
